nom: Urban Skin Rx Retinol Rapid Repair & Dark Spot Treatment

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily, acne-prone skin report reduced oiliness and clearer skin with regular use, though one reviewer found the line pore-clogging and too oily for her skin.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including acne-prone combination skin, report the treatment did not dry out their face and helped calm breakouts.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including some with rosacea or eczema, report reactions ranging from no irritation at all to severe burning, blistering, and in one case a trip to the emergency room.
segments.mature: One reviewer with aging skin, sun spots, and acne scars reports full confidence in the product's ability to fade discoloration over time.

concerns.redness: Several reviewers, including some with rosacea or normally non-sensitive skin, report severe burning, redness, and peeling severe enough that one went to the emergency room; others with acne-related redness report the azelaic acid in the formula calms inflammation instead.
concerns.barrier: A number of reviewers report the treatment dried out and damaged their skin barrier, causing dermatitis or cracked, peeling skin with frequent use, while others report no barrier issues even with nightly use.
concerns.spots: Most reviewers report visible fading of dark spots, melasma, and post-acne marks within two to four weeks of consistent use, though a few say they saw no change even after finishing a full bottle.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers with acne-prone or oily skin report fewer breakouts and faster healing of active pimples over weeks of use, alongside a retinol purging phase some experience early on.
concerns.aging: A handful of reviewers with sun spots and aging-related concerns report softer fine lines and improved texture alongside the dark-spot fading.

extraits.texte: Let me start by saying that my skin is very sensitive, 48 years old, impacted with rosacea and additional intermittent eczema. That being said this product line is purported to be safe for sensitive reactive aged skin. Also let me say that the reaction I experienced with this product line was not retinol purging. I had been using IS Clinical Products for several years including their anti-aging retinol products. Unfortunately I used these products only twice and I dealt with a severe flare up of rosacea & eczema. So now this cream sits in my plastic tub that collects products I have purchased yet can't use. I can't comment on long-term effectiveness or if the products work as claimed by marketing jargon. One other thing. WHAT is with the horrible scent of this product line? If I hadn't had a hypersensitivity reaction to these products and even if they worked as marketed I wouldn't have repurchased any of these products because they smell horrible.

extraits.titre: Horrible swollen and blistered dermatitis sent me to ER
extraits.texte: At almost 50 years old this product has been the only thing to ever send me to the ER. Only used it twice and after the second time noticed a small amount roughness on my face. The next day I started getting blisters on my face and neck and I started getting swollen. By the 3rd day after use I had horrible raised red blisters and my face was extremely swollen. I started to get a little worried that it was getting so much worse so decided to go to the ER. I typically don't have sensitive skin and I am literally burned. I just hope I don't end up with scarring.

I hate the peeling of skin by any product, but it heals any irritation or breakouts almost overnight and when i finish peeling my skin is even and glowing. It doesnt cause sensitivity to the sun causing more irritation either. It gives a chemical peel you get at a spa for hundreds of dollars at home for us sensetive skin girlies while healing hyperpigmentation. Ty skinrx for making effective products and not switching up formulas it was the breakthrough my skin needed after hormonal breakouts and awful hyperpigmentation in 2018 and still is when i use new irritating products and need healing.
